newsitem.title: USA: CollaGenex files for stock offer.
newsitem.headline: CollaGenex files for stock offer.

text.p: CollaGenex Pharmaceuticals Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 1 million shares of common stock.

The Newtown, Pa., developer of therapies to treat periodonal disease and other dental problems said proceeds from the sale will be used for the marketing expenses of introducing new products, to establish sales and marketing capabilities, for product development and other general corporate purposes.
Underwriter Alex. Brown & Sons Inc. has been granted an over-allotment option to buy up to 150,000 additional shares, the company said.
